title: The Multilingual Divide and Its Impact on Global AI Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance, tokenization costs, and rates of harmful or irrelevant generations across high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource languages, including human evaluations of safety guardrail effectiveness.

Analyzing standard multitask benchmarks (such as MMLU) to quantify the percentage of questions that require culture-specific knowledge and mapping the geographic distribution of these questions to demonstrate a Western-centric skew.
